caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture, likely a chest or a cabinet, shown from the front. The chest is rectangular with a flat top and stands on six curved legs. It has two columns of three drawers, one column on each side, and a central arched compartment at the bottom with a single door. Above the central compartment and the top two drawers on each side, there are three large, semicircular fan-shaped carved decorations. The wood is rendered in a medium to dark brown color, with visible wood grain texture. The drawer handles and keyholes are golden yellow, ornate in style, and contrast with the brown wood. The background of the drawing is an off-white color with some small brown spots. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature that reads (Michael TREKUR 36. N.Y.).
title: Dressing Table
